verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a video SDK/platform. Client SDKs can plausibly collect usage data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Video Insights and the Network Quality API are analytics features, not opt-out controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
